confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Nha Trang's pricing, not inspected listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July peak-season demand and beach-front location. Cocktail and wine are bounded by local beer and restaurant price levels, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Vietnamese beach resort priced between Da Nang and Hoi An and below Ho Chi Minh City. July is peak summer season for the coast, so accommodation anchors reflect seasonal demand.
